tweets.text: Still don't know what to get the recovery-obsessed person in your life this Christmas? We ranked the best sleep & recovery gifts by WHO you're buying for — not just what's trending. 🧵

Quick cheat sheet 👇
🎁 For him → Theragun Mini (muscle recovery, dead simple to use)
🎁 For her → Oura Ring Gen4 (sleep tracking, wears like jewelry)
🎁 For your athlete friend → Normatec Go compression boots
🎁 For tired parents → HigherDose Sauna Blanket (relaxation, zero gym required)
Budget alternatives for each are in the full guide.

Before: another candle or gift card they forget by February.
After: a gift that actually improves their sleep, recovery, or stress levels all year.
The difference is buying for the person, not for the trend.

Full breakdown: comparison table, budget picks, and which of these gifts to actually AVOID for certain people → https://lionlion0201-jpg.github.io/home-recovery-blog/posts/2026-recovery-sleep-gift-guide-by-recipient/
